ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the input on the left is x(t), entering a summing node; the x(t) terminal is marked with a positive sign. The output y(t) is output from the right side of the integrator, then returns to the negative terminal of the summing node through the lower feedback branch. Therefore the error signal output by the summing node is e(t)=x(t)-y(t), this signal enters the integrator, and the integrator output is y(t). Then reason: The integrator relation is y(t)=∫e(t)dt, so differentiating with respect to time gives dy(t)/dt=e(t)=x(t)-y(t). For the unit impulse response, let the input x(t)=δ(t), and the output y(t)=h(t), so dh(t)/dt=δ(t)-h(t), and rearranging gives dh(t)/dt+h(t)=δ(t).

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it shows x(t) added at the + terminal, y(t) fed back to the − terminal, and the resulting error signal entering an integrator whose output is y(t). Let the integrator input be e(t)=x(t)-y(t). Since y(t)=∫e(t)dt, differentiate to get dy(t)/dt=e(t)=x(t)-y(t). For the unit impulse response, substitute x(t)=δ(t) and y(t)=h(t), yielding dh(t)/dt=δ(t)-h(t), or dh(t)/dt+h(t)=δ(t).

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a closed loop where the forward path after the summing node is an integrator and the output is fed back with a minus sign. Model the integrator as G(s)=1/s and apply the unity negative-feedback formula: H(s)=G(s)/(1+G(s))=(1/s)/(1+1/s)=1/(s+1). Therefore (s+1)H(s)=1. Interpreting H(s) as the Laplace transform of the impulse response h(t), this operator equation corresponds to dh(t)/dt+h(t)=δ(t).
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个连续时间闭环系统。输入 x(t) 从左侧进入加法结点，加法结点处输入端标有“+”；输出 y(t) 从积分器后方取出，并沿下方反馈支路回到加法结点，反馈端标有“-”。加法结点后的前向通道是一个积分器，输出为 y(t)。

再推理：积分器的传递函数为 G(s)=1/s，且图中为单位负反馈。因此从输入到输出的闭环传递函数为 H(s)=G(s)/(1+G(s))=(1/s)/(1+1/s)=1/(s+1)。所以 (s+1)H(s)=1。若 H(s) 是单位冲激响应 h(t) 的拉普拉斯变换，则乘以 s 对应时域微分算子，右端 1 对应 δ(t)，因此系统的单位冲激响应满足 dh(t)/dt + h(t) = δ(t)。
